title: Cinematic flow films: a real 3-D wake, lit
description: A 3-D lattice Boltzmann solve of a body, rendered as smoke. The pipeline is three separable steps — solve (WindTunnelLBM, D3Q19 with Smagorinsky LES, snapshots of speed and the Q-criterion written to disk), render (Blender EEVEE with the field written as an OpenVDB density grid) and assemble (ffmpeg, plus a caption drawn outside the camera) — so the look can be retuned against the same solve. Three cases ship: the parametric RoadCar with a moving road, a NACA 2412 wing at 16 degrees, and a two-stage launcher. The volume is the simulated Q-criterion, not a texture. Every film writes ficha.json with the mesh, the lattice Reynolds number, the physical Reynolds number it stands for and the step count.
